problem: Execute r94 continuation: recompute the two N=128 shared corner rectangles with widened probability brackets and directed/high-precision arithmetic, then begin adaptive shared-rectangle coverage of the remaining 16x16 theta grid without weakening the frozen evidence scope.

shared_patch_outward_recomputation.probability_grid: N=128. Reconstructed the same scipy binary64 Beta(31/2,3) and Beta(37/2,37/2) quantiles used by r93/r94, widened every interior endpoint by 1e-8 plus an additional 1e-15 outward guard. The extra guard is far below the previously independently verified minimum exact-CDF slack (1.733e-9 for R and 2.927e-9 for U).
shared_patch_outward_recomputation.theta_guard: Each shared theta rectangle boundary was expanded outward by 1e-16 before evaluation.
shared_patch_outward_recomputation.arithmetic: Decimal precision 70 for directed floor/ceiling algebra. sqrt and exp were evaluated at precision 120, expanded by one 120-digit neighboring Decimal on each side, then rounded outward to precision 70. The R/U boxes were reconstructed monotonically, negative-curvature boxes used 3.817*H_lower, and nonnegative boxes used a lower p_min / upper p_rho ratio. Summation was downward-rounded.
shared_patch_outward_recomputation.cross_backend_check: Independent 80-digit mpmath recomputation on the same extra-widened boxes agreed with the Decimal sums to far below 1e-20 in the aggregate; the largest observed per-cell Decimal-vs-mpmath discrepancy was about 2.4e-24. The displayed guarded lowers subtract 1e-9, vastly larger than the observed cross-backend discrepancy.
shared_patch_outward_recomputation.result: Both r94 shared corner rectangles remain strictly positive under the widened probability grid and outward/high-precision arithmetic path. The seven low-margin r92 cells therefore remain collapsed to two shared proof obligations. This is a strong machine-numerical certificate, but not a proof-assistant/MPFI-grade theorem because the trusted Decimal transcendental implementation and the already-certified quantile centers are still external numerical components.

adaptive_remaining_grid_discovery.method: Ordinary binary64 engineering discovery only. Precompute widened Beta/Jacobi boxes and apply the same sign-safe lower envelope. Individual theta cells were tested at N=256; 215/256 were positive and 41 were nonpositive. The 41 nonpositive cells form a central low-mu wedge. Retesting exactly those 41 at N=512 made all 41 positive; the worst N=512 score among them was 2.66784202635.
adaptive_remaining_grid_discovery.n256_nonpositive_pattern: 41 cells: mu index 0 with sigma 4..13; mu 1 with sigma 4..13; mu 2 with sigma 4..12; mu 3 with sigma 5..11; mu 4 with sigma 6..10.
adaptive_remaining_grid_discovery.shared_recursive_cover: A deterministic split rule over the 16x16 theta grid, accepting a rectangle only when its engineering lower sum exceeded 0.2 at the first successful resolution among N=128,256,512, produced a complete partition into 46 positive shared rectangles with no individual failures. Smallest accepted margin was 0.20426494582. Representative low-margin groups include mu 4..5 x sigma 0..1 at N=256 (0.20426494582), mu 8..11 x sigma 0..3 at N=512 (0.37629785825), mu 4..5 x sigma 12..15 at N=512 (0.48290852105), mu 0..1 x sigma 12..13 at N=512 (0.69112174994), and mu 0..1 x sigma 2..3 at N=512 (0.70765909710).
adaptive_remaining_grid_discovery.negative_result: Coarse shared envelopes can be much looser than individual envelopes. For example, the full 16x16 rectangle is negative even at N=64, and broad rectangles covering the N=256 central wedge remain negative at N=512. Thus global one-rectangle monotonic transport is not supported; adaptive partition/refinement is the better proof route.
adaptive_remaining_grid_discovery.scope: These 46-cover and N=256/N=512 results are engineering discovery only, not outward-certified. They are used to choose the next deterministic proof partition, not as a final curvature theorem.

The current lower-envelope construction appears sufficient for every individual theta cell without new analytic machinery: 215 cells are already positive at N=256 engineering resolution and the remaining 41 become positive at N=512.
Adaptive shared-rectangle proof search is feasible: a simple 46-rectangle partition covers all 256 theta cells with engineering margin >0.2, while overly broad rectangles fail.
negative_or_scope_evidence: The two shared-corner numbers are not claimed as proof-assistant-grade directed intervals; they still trust Decimal sqrt/exp plus already validated quantile centers, although generous outward guards and independent high-precision checks were applied.
The 46-rectangle global cover is binary64 engineering guidance only and must be recomputed with the outward path before it can replace the randomized/global curvature evidence.
The 46-rectangle split is one deterministic heuristic partition, not proven minimal.
All claims remain restricted to the standardized frozen m=32 NIG/four-corner iid Gaussian setup and the existing r92 negative-ratio premise.
